analysis: Provided-feature-only Overture building-source prior sensitivity; diagnostic candidate, not a submission
limitations: Source labels indicate provenance metadata only; they do not establish geometry equality, footprint completeness, reference vintage, or matching with the hidden Microsoft reference.
The six exclusive source classes partition building records, but the separately reported Microsoft/OSM/Esri/other memberships overlap and must not be summed.
The source and context weights are fixed qualitative assumptions, not fitted rates or measured target gaps. This analysis has no labels or local accuracy metric.
A positive Overture count is used only for the already-documented component definedness convention; the two zero-count tracts retain undefined status and numeric placeholder zero.

allowed_inputs: provided feature-cache GEOID and overture_buildings count
provided Overture-derived mutually exclusive building source-class shares from bbox/sources

component_rule.baseline_defined_when: provided overture_buildings > 0; otherwise undefined with numeric placeholder 0
component_rule.candidate_formula: 0.01 + beta * (1 - total_support) when building_defined=1; otherwise numeric placeholder 0 and building_defined=0
component_rule.coefficient_rationale: predeclared qualitative source-attribution ordering and bounded perturbation around the constant 0.01 prior; coefficients are not fitted to any target, reference count, or leaderboard score

forbidden_inputs: sample score placeholders or hidden labels
MS, USFS, CarbonPlan, or any reference footprint counts, per-tract values, or external footprints
ACS housing-unit counts as a denominator or floor
external imagery or external footprint data
method.purpose: analysis-only near-zero building source-prior sensitivity; no upload, target RMSE, or accuracy claim
method.source_class_semantics: exclusive Overture source-dataset membership classes; class shares form a partition among assigned buildings. Source attribution is not proof of geometric identity, completeness, vintage, or reference match.

source_features.share_provenance: Existing workspace feature cache; derived from provided Overture bbox centers assigned to provided ACS GEOID/geometry and the provided Overture sources[].dataset field. No Overture building geometry or any reference footprint was read by this screen.
source_features.source_class_semantics: exclusive Overture source-dataset membership classes; class shares form a partition among assigned buildings. Source attribution is not proof of geometric identity, completeness, vintage, or reference match.
